description: Source code for a gateway tool module that handles restart, configuration inspection, application, patching, and updates via a structured schema and runtime validation. It includes functions for config validation, permission checks, and executing various gateway actions, with logging and restart scheduling.

methods.name: resolveBaseHashFromSnapshot
methods.description: Extracts the base hash from a snapshot object if available.

methods.name: getSnapshotConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the config object from a snapshot.

methods.name: parseGatewayConfigMutationRaw
methods.description: Parses raw JSON5 string for config mutation, ensuring it is an object.

methods.name: getValueAtCanonicalPath
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a nested config object using a dot-separated path.

methods.name: getValueAtPath
methods.description: Retrieves a value at a given path, with special handling for 'tools.exec.' paths.

methods.name: assertGatewayConfigMutationAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a config mutation is allowed by comparing protected paths.

methods.name: createGatewayTool
methods.description: Factory function that creates a gateway management tool with restart, config, and update capabilities.
